proof_audit.v13-c12-welfare: Strict derivative-sign proof gives the full clipped allocation and endpoint weights; a separate resource argument proves the entire Pareto frontier. Positive individual rescaling preserves preferences, not interpersonal sums.
proof_audit.v13-c12-global: Compactness supplies attainment, then the entire derivative factorization, interval signs and all endpoints/critical values establish the unique global quartic optimum. The sharp 2 epsilon + eta theorem requires a true uniform objective bound and global approximate-solver gap; no approximate maximum attainment is assumed.
proof_audit.v13-c12-selection: Every independent mixed support, including subsidy equality, is covered by strict/weak gain signs. Sponsor prefunding covers every realized transfer; cancellation yields real welfare. Recommendation-conditioned obedience uses the full joint law, not just its marginals.
proof_audit.v13-c12-approximation: Invariant interval, geometric Cauchy existence, continuity, uniqueness and convergence are proved separately. True residual, uniform parameter sensitivity and model/computation error decomposition have explicit bounds. A solved changed map is not the original map solved accurately.
proof_audit.v13-c12-identification: The complete no-tax law is the same in both models. Actual demand and supply include finite buyer/producer cash caps at off-equilibrium prices. Positive demand is strictly decreasing, capped supply nondecreasing; the unique computed clearing choices have strictly slack cash. Statewise benefit, cost, government and final-cash identities prove each tax comparison. Pilot discrimination is restricted to the maintained two-model class and deterministic error law.
proof_audit.v13-c12-referee: All fair- and zero-grant equilibria are derived. Unique full adoption over every mixed equilibrium holds iff at least one grant strictly exceeds its cost; necessity retains no adoption at equality, sufficiency uses a dominant adopter. The equality segment, unattained budget infima, cost rectangle and equal-grant restriction are solved separately. The complete fictional report distinguishes theorem repair, new primitives, welfare recipients and evidence.
